name: WHO Adult Triage: Severe Tachypnea (Respiratory Rate >= 30)
description: Adult respiratory rate >= 30 breaths/min indicates severe physiological distress or respiratory compensation.
section_number: Module 3: Airway and Breathing, Critical Vital Signs

consequent.clinical_action: Urgent immediate medical assessment, supplemental oxygen if indicated, and arterial blood gas consideration.
consequent.clinical_rationale: Marked tachypnea (RR >= 30) is one of the most sensitive single vital sign markers of impending physiological collapse.

name: WHO Adult Triage: Moderate Hypoxemia (SpO2 90-93% with Dyspnea)
description: Adult oxygen saturation between 90% and 93% accompanied by active dyspnea.
section_number: Module 3: Airway and Breathing, Moderate Distress

consequent.clinical_action: Prompt emergency department assessment within 1 hour; titrate oxygen to target SpO2 94-98% (or 88-92% in hypercapnic respiratory failure).
consequent.clinical_rationale: SpO2 90-93% with breathlessness indicates compromised pulmonary gas exchange requiring rapid clinician evaluation.
